studies.study_title: Aduvant progesterone therapy for stage 1 endometrial cancer
studies.predicted_reason: This study describes 35 patients with stage IA or IB endometrial carcinoma who were treated with total abdominal hysterectomy and bilateral salpingo-oophorectomy (surgery). After surgery, 18 patients received 6-methyl-17α-hydroxyprogesterone (a progestagen) and 17 patients received placebo on a similar schedule. The comparison of treatment versus placebo after surgery in a defined cohort indicates this is a controlled trial of adjuvant progestagen therapy following surgery for stage 1 endometrial cancer. Although the abstract does not explicitly use the word 'randomised', the structured comparison of hormone versus placebo after surgery in an identical schedule strongly suggests an RCT design. Applying the conservative principle, this study is included.
